title: How to Sell Onecoins
description: To join me at Onecoin: https://www.onecoin.eu/signup/thomasp31.

First thing to know, you cannot sell your Onecoin with one coin, as soon as it is mined and you have it at your back office. Go down, click on Place order, and then click on Sell to coin. Your demand will then be available here in pending. For her to be validated, another number has to be accepted, and now, it's asked by the reverse order. Which means, if you want to sell 2 COINA another member has to wanted to buy 2 at the same time if that's not not the case after 7 days your transaction will therefore be displayed executed, if the opposite works it will be indicated executed like here other important factor you have also limits depending on the pack that you have it is just displayed here at the window that limit on the pack It's shown right here at the display. For starter and trader packs you can sell 12€ per day For Pro and Executive Traders, you can sell 36€. For Tycoon Traders, you can sell 60€. And for the premium and festival packs, you can sell 150€ per day.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes joining and selling through a paid OneCoin account while presenting package-based access limits, bonuses, sponsored members and leadership status as part of the participation system. The description directly invites viewers to join the speaker at Onecoin, and the tutorial operationally guides viewers through placing a sell order, encouraging participation rather than warning about or investigating the offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promoted system visibly includes directly sponsored members, rookie members, leadership rank, bonuses and multiple paid account packages, indicating a multi-person qualification and earnings structure. The video combines those hierarchy-related features with a direct invitation to join and instructions for using the account, rather than merely discussing the system critically.
